title: Pipelayers
description: Lay pipe for storm or sanitation sewers, drains, and water mains. Perform any combination of the following tasks: grade trenches or culverts, position pipe, or seal joints.

tasks.text: Grade or level trench bases, using tamping machines or hand tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Operating compaction equipment by hand on site

dwas.name: Compact materials to create level bases.

tasks.text: Dig trenches to desired or required depths, by hand or using trenching tools.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Manual digging with tools in ground
physical manipulation — Metal cutting with tools, hands-on

tasks.text: Install or use instruments such as lasers, grade rods, or transit levels.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Positioning hand tools requires manual dexterity

tasks.text: Cover pipes with earth or other materials.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on spreading of loose materials

dwas.name: Spread sand, dirt or other loose materials onto surfaces.

tasks.text: Connect pipe pieces and seal joints, using welding equipment, cement, or glue.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Welding is skilled hands-on metalwork

tasks.text: Install or repair sanitary or stormwater sewer structures or pipe systems.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Plumbing repair is manual dexterity in situ

tasks.text: Check slopes for conformance to requirements, using levels or lasers.
tasks.rationale: decision support — AI can review specs/docs; physical project check is human

dwas.name: Evaluate projects to determine compliance with technical specifications.

tasks.text: Align and position pipes to prepare them for welding or sealing.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on plumbing in structures

tasks.text: Lay out pipe routes, following written instructions or blueprints and coordinating layouts with supervisors.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — On-site construction discussion is contextual, physical

dwas.name: Mark reference points on construction materials.
Communicate with other construction or extraction personnel to discuss project details.
dwas.gwa_name: Communicating with Supervisors, Peers, or Subordinates

tasks.text: Tap and drill holes into pipes to introduce auxiliary lines or devices.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Drilling construction materials is hands-on tool work

tasks.text: Operate mechanized equipment, such as pickup trucks, rollers, tandem dump trucks, front-end loaders, or backhoes.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Truck driving needs real-world navigation and control

dwas.name: Operate equipment or vehicles to clear construction sites or move materials.
Drive trucks or truck-mounted equipment.
dwas.gwa_name: Operating Vehicles, Mechanized Devices, or Equipment

tasks.text: Train or supervise others in laying pipe.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Construction training requires hands-on demonstration and safety

tasks.text: Locate existing pipes needing repair or replacement, using magnetic or radio indicators.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Physical locating of worn parts needs hands-on presence

dwas.name: Locate equipment or materials in need of repair or replacement.
